text:
inc-bot: [PAGING] High p95 and throughput degradation detected in us-west inference cluster (gpu-pool-7). Trigger: p95 token latency +2.4x and sustained queue growth > 60s. Paging eng-oncall @sasha and ops rotators.

sasha: ack — picking this up. I'm on the cluster console now. seeing KV eviction spikes and intermittent kvproxy 503s.

evan: adding initial metrics snapshot: CPU on host-gpu-12 at 92%, token service queue length trending up. logs: `kvproxy ERROR: get_kv timed out 1200ms` repeated.

priya: suggestion — flip routing to fallback pool smaller-bin-2 and enable legacy-kv-cache for 10m. That should reduce KV pressure while we investigate eviction churn.

sasha: doing graceful routing shift now — running: `redwood route update --from gpu-pool-7 --to smaller-bin-2 --shift 30% --grace 60s`

evan: confirmed 30% traffic shifted, p95 dropped ~15% in the first minute. queue length decreasing.

mike: composing status page blurb (draft):
"We are investigating increased inference latency and request queueing in the US-WEST region affecting some hosted API requests. We have started traffic rerouting to an alternate pool and expect a progressive improvement over the next 10-30 minutes. No customer data loss is expected. We will post updates as we have them."

julie: suggested customer-facing notice (short):
"We're currently mitigating increased API latency in US-WEST. We've applied a traffic reroute and performance should improve within 30 minutes. If you continue to see errors, please contact support@redwood.ai and include request IDs. Apologies for the disruption."

priya: mitigation step list (for runbook):
1) confirm kvproxy process restart readiness
2) enable legacy-kv-cache at 10m TTL: `kv-config set --pool gpu-pool-7 --legacy-cache enabled --ttl 600`
3) initiate phased routing shift (30% -> 60% -> 100%) with 60s ramp windows
4) monitor p95, qlen, kvproxy error rate, and GPU util
5) if no improvement after 30m, escalate to infra and consider emergency scale-up of smaller-bin-2

sasha: executing step 2 now. leaving a note in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incident/4412345678 (link)

evan: p95 improved another 12% after enabling legacy cache. kvproxy error rate down 70%. queue length trending normal.

mike: posting status page update now. also pinged support to surface to high-touch customers and posted the customer notice draft to #customer-success for signoff.

sasha: moving to monitoring mode. I'll stay on for handoff in 30m unless things regress. If stable, I'll close the page and mark as mitigated.

julie: thumbs: :thumbsup: — queued customer emails for customers with open incidents.

inc-bot: [UPDATE] Mitigation in progress. Traffic reroute and cache change applied. Monitoring for stability.

sasha: handoff to @priya at 4412345945 — leaving runbook steps and current metrics in the incident doc. Priya takes lead for next 1h.

priya: ack handoff. I'll continue monitoring and prepare a short post-incident summary once things are stable.

mike: final note for comms: include "what we did" bullets and expected impact in the status page follow-up.

inc-bot: [RESOLVE_CHECK] If no regressions in next 45m, incident will be marked mitigated and follow-up postmortem scheduled.
